passages.text: “Now if you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God and are careful to follow all His commandments I am giving you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He gives you commandments today.
You must listen carefully to His voice.
You must obey all His commandments.
If you do this, the LORD your God will act.
He will place you above every nation on earth.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם וּנְתָ֨נְךָ֜ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עֶלְי֔וֹן עַ֖ל כָּל־ גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you, if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
If you obey the voice of the LORD your God, blessings will come to you.
These blessings will reach you wherever you are.
You will be blessed in the city.
You will be blessed in the country.
passages.original: וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ כָּל־ הַבְּרָכ֥וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֻ֑ךָ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֔ע בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בָּעִ֑יר וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

passages.text: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock— the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God gives commandments.
God promises blessings if you obey Him.
God will bless your children.
God will bless the crops that grow in your land.
God will bless the young animals born to your livestock.
God will bless the calves born to your cattle.
God will bless the lambs born to your flocks.
passages.original: בָּר֧וּךְ פְּרִֽי־ בִטְנְךָ֛ וּפְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י בְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God gives blessings to those who obey Him.
God will bless your basket.
God will bless your kneading bowl.
passages.original: בָּר֥וּךְ טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God gives blessings.
You will be blessed when you come in.
You will be blessed when you go out.
passages.original: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: The LORD will cause the enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you. They will march out against you in one direction but flee from you in seven.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will act for you.
Your enemies may rise up against you.
The LORD will defeat your enemies before you.
Your enemies will come toward you from one direction.
Your enemies will flee from you in seven directions.
passages.original: יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ אֹיְבֶ֙יךָ֙ הַקָּמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ נִגָּפִ֖ים לְפָנֶ֑יךָ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ יֵצְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים יָנ֥וּסוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: The LORD will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand; the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will command a blessing for you.
He will bless your barns.
He will bless everything you do with your hands.
The LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.
passages.original: יְצַ֨ו יְהוָ֤ה אִתְּךָ֙ אֶת־ הַבְּרָכָ֔ה בַּאֲסָמֶ֕יךָ וּבְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וּבֵ֣רַכְךָ֔ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: The LORD will establish you as His holy people, just as He has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD has sworn to you.
The LORD will make you His holy people.
You must keep the commandments of the LORD your God.
You must walk in the ways of the LORD.
If you do these things, the LORD will establish you as His holy people.
passages.original: יְקִֽימְךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם קָד֔וֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע־ לָ֑ךְ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־ מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will stand in awe of you.
passages.sermon: All the peoples of the earth will see you.\r\nThey will see that the name of the LORD is called upon you.\r\nThey will stand in awe of you.
passages.original: וְרָאוּ֙ כָּל־ עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה נִקְרָ֣א עָלֶ֑יךָ וְיָֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

passages.text: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly—in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land—in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD promised to give your fathers a land.
The LORD will give you this land.
The LORD will make you prosper in this land.
You will have many children.
Your livestock will have many offspring.
Your land will produce much food.
The LORD will do all this for your good.
passages.original: וְהוֹתִֽרְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ לְטוֹבָ֔ה בִּפְרִ֧י בִטְנְךָ֛ וּבִפְרִ֥י בְהַמְתְּךָ֖ וּבִפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָ֥תֶת לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: The LORD will open the heavens, His abundant storehouse, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations, but borrow from none.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will open the heavens for you.
The heavens are His abundant storehouse.
The LORD will send rain on your land at the right time.
The LORD will bless all the work of your hands.
You will lend to many nations.
You will not borrow from anyone.
passages.original: יִפְתַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה׀ לְ֠ךָ אֶת־ אוֹצָר֨וֹ הַטּ֜וֹב אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם לָתֵ֤ת מְטַֽר־ אַרְצְךָ֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֕ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהִלְוִ֙יתָ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א תִלְוֶֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD will make you the head and not the tail; you will only move upward and never downward, if you hear and carefully follow the commandments of the LORD your God, which I am giving you today.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will make you the head.
You will not be the tail.
You will always be above.
You will not be below.
This will happen if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God.
I am giving you these commandments today.
You must keep them and do them.
passages.original: וּנְתָֽנְךָ֨ יְהוָ֤ה לְרֹאשׁ֙ וְלֹ֣א לְזָנָ֔ב וְהָיִ֙יתָ֙ רַ֣ק לְמַ֔עְלָה וְלֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לְמָ֑טָּה כִּֽי־ תִשְׁמַ֞ע אֶל־ מִצְוֺ֣ת׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם לִשְׁמֹ֥ר וְלַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

passages.text: Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words I command you today, and do not go after other gods to serve them.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God gives commands today.
Do not turn away from these commands.
Do not turn to the right.
Do not turn to the left.
Do not follow other gods.
Do not serve other gods.
passages.original: וְלֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִכָּל־ הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לָלֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים לְעָבְדָֽם׃ס

passages.text: If, however, you do not obey the LORD your God by carefully following all His commandments and statutes I am giving you today, all these curses will come upon you and overtake you: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
I am giving you commandments and statutes today.
You must listen to the voice of the LORD your God.
You must carefully keep and do all His commandments and statutes.
If you do not obey the LORD your God,
If you do not keep and do all His commandments and statutes I am giving you today,
All these curses will come upon you.
These curses will overtake you.
You will be cursed in the city.
You will be cursed in the country.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ לֹ֤א תִשְׁמַע֙ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ כָּל־ הַקְּלָל֥וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֽוּךָ׃ אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בָּעִ֑יר וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

passages.text: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God gave them commandments and laws.
God warned them about disobedience.
If you do not obey God,
God will bring curses upon you.
Your basket will be cursed.
Your kneading bowl will be cursed.
passages.original: אָר֥וּר טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, as well as the produce of your land, the calves of your herds, and the lambs of your flocks.
passages.sermon:
God gave commandments and statutes to His people.
God warned His people to obey Him.
If you do not obey God, He will send curses.
Your children will be cursed.
The crops from your land will be cursed.
The calves born to your cattle will be cursed.
The lambs born to your flocks will be cursed.
passages.original: אָר֥וּר פְּרִֽי־ בִטְנְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them about disobedience.
God says, “You will be cursed when you come in.”
God says, “You will be cursed when you go out.”
passages.original: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed in forsaking Him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will send curses upon you.
The LORD will send confusion upon you.
The LORD will send reproof upon you.
These will come in everything you do.
These will come in all the work of your hands.
The LORD will do this until you are destroyed.
The LORD will do this until you quickly perish.
You will perish because of your wickedness.
You have committed wickedness by forsaking the LORD.
passages.original: יְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה׀ בְּ֠ךָ אֶת־ הַמְּאֵרָ֤ה אֶת־ הַמְּהוּמָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַמִּגְעֶ֔רֶת בְּכָל־ מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמֶדְךָ֤ וְעַד־ אֲבָדְךָ֙ מַהֵ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֛י רֹ֥עַ מַֽעֲלָלֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲזַבְתָּֽנִי׃

passages.text: The LORD will make the plague cling to you until He has exterminated you from the land that you are entering to possess.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will send a plague upon you.
The plague will stay with you.
The plague will not leave you.
The LORD will do this until you are destroyed.
You are entering a land to possess it.
The LORD will remove you from that land by this plague.
passages.original: יַדְבֵּ֧ק יְהוָ֛ה בְּךָ֖ אֶת־ הַדָּ֑בֶר עַ֚ד כַּלֹּת֣וֹ אֹֽתְךָ֔ מֵעַל֙ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew; these will pursue you until you perish.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will strike you.
He will strike you with wasting disease.
He will strike you with fever.
He will strike you with inflammation.
He will strike you with scorching heat.
He will strike you with drought.
He will strike you with blight.
He will strike you with mildew.
These troubles will pursue you.
They will pursue you until you perish.
passages.original: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְ֠הוָה בַּשַּׁחֶ֨פֶת וּבַקַּדַּ֜חַת וּבַדַּלֶּ֗קֶת וּבַֽחַרְחֻר֙ וּבַחֶ֔רֶב וּבַשִּׁדָּפ֖וֹן וּבַיֵּרָק֑וֹן וּרְדָפ֖וּךָ עַ֥ד אָבְדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: The sky over your head will be bronze, and the earth beneath you iron.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking to Israel.
God warns Israel about punishment for disobedience.
God says the sky over your head will become like bronze.
God says the earth beneath you will become like iron.
passages.original: וְהָי֥וּ שָׁמֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ רֹאשְׁךָ֖ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ תַּחְתֶּ֖יךָ בַּרְזֶֽל׃

passages.text: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder; it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will act with power.
The LORD will change the rain in your land.
The LORD will make your rain become dust and powder.
Dust and powder will fall from the sky onto you.
This will continue until you are destroyed.
passages.original: יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מְטַ֥ר אַרְצְךָ֖ אָבָ֣ק וְעָפָ֑ר מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ יֵרֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃

passages.text: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will march out against them in one direction but flee from them in seven. You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will act against you.
The LORD will cause your enemies to defeat you.
You will go out to fight your enemies in one direction.
You will run away from your enemies in seven directions.
All the kingdoms of the earth will see you.
They will be horrified by what happens to you.
passages.original: יִתֶּנְךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה׀ נִגָּף֮ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶיךָ֒ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ תֵּצֵ֣א אֵלָ֔יו וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים תָּנ֣וּס לְפָנָ֑יו וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְזַעֲוָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
He warns them about the consequences of disobedience.
Your dead bodies will lie on the ground.
Birds in the sky will come and eat your corpses.
Wild animals on the earth will also eat your corpses.
No one will drive the birds or animals away.
passages.original: וְהָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָֽתְךָ֙ לְמַאֲכָ֔ל לְכָל־ ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃

passages.text: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt, with tumors and scabs and itch from which you cannot be cured.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will punish you if you disobey Him.
The LORD will strike you with painful sores.
These sores are like the boils that came upon Egypt.
The LORD will also strike you with tumors.
He will strike you with scabs.
He will strike you with an itch.
You will not be able to heal from these diseases.
No cure will help you.
passages.original: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֤ין מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וּבָעֳפָלִים וּבַגָּרָ֖ב וּבֶחָ֑רֶס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵֽא׃

passages.text: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness, and confusion of mind, and at noon you will grope about like a blind man in the darkness. You will not prosper in your ways. Day after day you will be oppressed and plundered, with no one to save you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will strike you.
He will give you madness.
He will make you blind.
He will fill your mind with confusion.
You will grope at noon.
You will reach out as a blind man gropes in darkness.
You will not succeed in your ways.
You will be oppressed every day.
You will be robbed every day.
No one will save you.
passages.original: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּשִׁגָּע֖וֹן וּבְעִוָּר֑וֹן וּבְתִמְה֖וֹן לֵבָֽב׃ וְהָיִ֜יתָ מְמַשֵּׁ֣שׁ בַּֽצָּהֳרַ֗יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְמַשֵּׁ֤שׁ הָעִוֵּר֙ בָּאֲפֵלָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחַ אֶת־ דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֜יתָ אַ֣ךְ עָשׁ֧וּק וְגָז֛וּל כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֖ים וְאֵ֥ין מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

passages.text: You will be pledged in marriage to a woman, but another man will violate her. You will build a house but will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard but will not enjoy its fruit.
passages.sermon:
God warns the people of Israel about the consequences of disobedience.
You will become engaged to a woman.
Another man will take her instead.
You will build a house.
You will not live in that house.
You will plant a vineyard.
You will not eat its fruit.
passages.original: אִשָּׁ֣ה תְאָרֵ֗שׂ וְאִ֤ישׁ אַחֵר֙ יִשְׁגָּלֶנָּה בַּ֥יִת תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְלֹא־ תֵשֵׁ֣ב בּ֑וֹ כֶּ֥רֶם תִּטַּ֖ע וְלֹ֥א תְחַלְּלֶּֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be taken away and not returned to you. Your flock will be given to your enemies, and no one will save you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God warns Israel about punishment for disobedience.
You will see your ox killed in front of you.
You will not eat any of its meat.
Someone will take your donkey away from you.
Your donkey will not come back to you.
Your enemies will take your flock of sheep.
No one will save you.
passages.original: שׁוֹרְךָ֞ טָב֣וּחַ לְעֵינֶ֗יךָ וְלֹ֣א תֹאכַל֮ מִמֶּנּוּ֒ חֲמֹֽרְךָ֙ גָּז֣וּל מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב לָ֑ךְ צֹֽאנְךָ֙ נְתֻנ֣וֹת לְאֹיְבֶ֔יךָ וְאֵ֥ין לְךָ֖ מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

passages.text: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, while your eyes grow weary looking for them day after day, with no power in your hand.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God warns about punishment for disobedience.
Your sons will be taken from you.
Your daughters will be taken from you.
Another nation will receive your children.
You will see this happen with your own eyes.
You will look for your children every day.
You will grow tired and weak from looking for them.
You will have no power to bring them back.
You will not be able to help them.
passages.original: בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֜יךָ נְתֻנִ֨ים לְעַ֤ם אַחֵר֙ וְעֵינֶ֣יךָ רֹא֔וֹת וְכָל֥וֹת אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם כָּל־ הַיּ֑וֹם וְאֵ֥ין לְאֵ֖ל יָדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil. All your days you will be oppressed and crushed.
passages.sermon:
A people you do not know will come.
They will eat the produce of your land.
They will eat everything you have worked for.
You will be oppressed every day.
You will be crushed all your days.
passages.original: פְּרִ֤י אַדְמָֽתְךָ֙ וְכָל־ יְגִ֣יעֲךָ֔ יֹאכַ֥ל עַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ יָדָ֑עְתָּ וְהָיִ֗יתָ רַ֛ק עָשׁ֥וּק וְרָצ֖וּץ כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃

passages.text: You will be driven mad by the sights you see.
passages.sermon:
God warned Israel about punishment for disobedience.
God said, “You will see terrible things.”
These sights will overwhelm you.
You will lose your sanity because of what you see.
passages.original: וְהָיִ֖יתָ מְשֻׁגָּ֑ע מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD will afflict you with painful, incurable boils on your knees and thighs, from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will act against you.
The LORD will strike you with boils.
These boils will be very painful.
These boils will not heal.
The boils will cover your knees.
The boils will cover your thighs.
The boils will spread from the soles of your feet.
The boils will reach to the top of your head.
passages.original: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֣ין רָ֗ע עַל־ הַבִּרְכַּ֙יִם֙ וְעַל־ הַשֹּׁקַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵ֑א מִכַּ֥ף רַגְלְךָ֖ וְעַ֥ד קָדְקֳדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: The LORD will bring you and the king you appoint to a nation neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you will worship other gods—gods of wood and stone.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will act with power.
The LORD will take you away.
The LORD will take your king with you.
You will go to a foreign nation.
You do not know this nation.
Your fathers did not know this nation.
In that nation, you will serve other gods.
These gods are not real.
These gods are made of wood and stone.
passages.original: יוֹלֵ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֹֽתְךָ֗ וְאֶֽת־ מַלְכְּךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּקִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ אֶל־ גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יָדַ֖עְתָּ אַתָּ֣ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְעָבַ֥דְתָּ שָּׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃

passages.text: You will become an object of horror, scorn, and ridicule among all the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will drive you to many nations.
You will live among these nations.
All these nations will see you.
They will look at you with horror.
They will scorn you.
They will ridicule you.
You will become an object of horror, scorn, and ridicule among all these nations.
passages.original: וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה לְמָשָׁ֖ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֑ה בְּכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ יְנַהֶגְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה שָֽׁמָּה׃

passages.text: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will consume it.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
You will plant many seeds in your fields.
You will gather only a small harvest.
Locusts will eat most of your crops.
passages.original: זֶ֥רַע רַ֖ב תּוֹצִ֣יא הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּמְעַ֣ט תֶּאֱסֹ֔ף כִּ֥י יַחְסְלֶ֖נּוּ הָאַרְבֶּֽה׃

passages.text: You will plant and cultivate vineyards, but will neither drink the wine nor gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God warns Israel about disobedience.
You will plant vineyards.
You will work in the vineyards.
You will not drink the wine from your vineyards.
You will not gather the grapes from your vineyards.
Worms will eat the grapes.
passages.original: כְּרָמִ֥ים תִּטַּ֖ע וְעָבָ֑דְתָּ וְיַ֤יִן לֹֽא־ תִשְׁתֶּה֙ וְלֹ֣א תֶאֱגֹ֔ר כִּ֥י תֹאכְלֶ֖נּוּ הַתֹּלָֽעַת׃

passages.text: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but will never anoint yourself with oil, because the olives will drop off.
passages.sermon: You will have olive trees in every part of your land.\r\nYou will not anoint yourself with oil.\r\nThe olives will fall off the trees.
passages.original: זֵיתִ֛ים יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּכָל־ גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְשֶׁ֙מֶן֙ לֹ֣א תָס֔וּךְ כִּ֥י יִשַּׁ֖ל זֵיתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not remain yours, because they will go into captivity.
passages.sermon:
You will have sons.
You will have daughters.
They will not stay with you.
They will go into captivity.
passages.original: בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנ֖וֹת תּוֹלִ֑יד וְלֹא־ יִהְי֣וּ לָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י יֵלְכ֖וּ בַּשֶּֽׁבִי׃

passages.text: Swarms of locusts will consume all your trees and the produce of your land.
passages.sermon: Swarms of locusts will come.\r\nThey will eat all your trees.\r\nThey will consume the produce of your land.
passages.original: כָּל־ עֵצְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ יְיָרֵ֖שׁ הַצְּלָצַֽל׃

passages.text: The foreigner living among you will rise higher and higher above you, while you sink down lower and lower.
passages.sermon:
A foreigner lives among you.
This foreigner will rise above you.
He will keep rising higher and higher.
You will sink below him.
You will keep going lower and lower.
passages.original: הַגֵּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֔ יַעֲלֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ מַ֣עְלָה מָּ֑עְלָה וְאַתָּ֥ה תֵרֵ֖ד מַ֥טָּה מָּֽטָּה׃

passages.text: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
passages.sermon:
The foreigner will lend to you.
You will not lend to the foreigner.
The foreigner will be the head.
You will be the tail.
passages.original: ה֣וּא יַלְוְךָ֔ וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֣א תַלְוֶ֑נּוּ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְרֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְזָנָֽב׃

passages.text: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, since you did not obey the LORD your God and keep the commandments and statutes He gave you.
passages.sermon:
God gave commandments and statutes to you.
God is the LORD your God.
You did not obey God.
You did not keep His commandments and statutes.
All these curses will come upon you.
These curses will pursue you.
These curses will overtake you.
These curses will continue until you are destroyed.
passages.original: וּבָ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ כָּל־ הַקְּלָל֣וֹת הָאֵ֗לֶּה וּרְדָפ֙וּךָ֙ וְהִשִּׂיג֔וּךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָ֑ךְ כִּי־ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel commandments and statutes.
\r\nGod warned Israel about disobedience.
\r\nIf Israel disobeys, curses will come.
\r\nThese curses will be a sign.
\r\nThese curses will be a wonder.
\r\nThese curses will come upon you.
\r\nThese curses will come upon your descendants.
\r\nThese curses will last forever.
passages.original: וְהָי֣וּ בְךָ֔ לְא֖וֹת וּלְמוֹפֵ֑ת וּֽבְזַרְעֲךָ֖ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance, you will serve your enemies the LORD will send against you in famine, thirst, nakedness, and destitution. He will place an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you.
passages.sermon:
You did not serve the LORD your God.
You did not serve Him with joy.
You did not serve Him with gladness of heart.
You had abundance, but you did not serve Him gladly.
Because of this, you will serve your enemies.
The LORD will send these enemies against you.
You will serve them in famine.
You will serve them in thirst.
You will serve them in nakedness.
You will serve them in total need.
The LORD will put an iron yoke on your neck.
He will do this until He destroys you.
passages.original: תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־ עָבַ֙דְתָּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּשִׂמְחָ֖ה וּבְט֣וּב לֵבָ֑ב מֵרֹ֖ב כֹּֽל׃ וְעָבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת־ אֹיְבֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשַׁלְּחֶ֤נּוּ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ בְּרָעָ֧ב וּבְצָמָ֛א וּבְעֵירֹ֖ם וּבְחֹ֣סֶר כֹּ֑ל וְנָתַ֞ן עֹ֤ל בַּרְזֶל֙ עַל־ צַוָּארֶ֔ךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ׃

passages.text: The LORD will bring a nation from afar, from the ends of the earth, to swoop down upon you like an eagle—a nation whose language you will not understand, a ruthless nation with no respect for the old and no pity for the young.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will act.
The LORD will bring a nation against you.
This nation will come from far away.
They will come from the ends of the earth.
They will come quickly, like an eagle swoops down.
You will not understand their language.
This nation will be fierce and strong.
They will show no respect for old people.
They will show no mercy to young people.
passages.original: יִשָּׂ֣א יְהוָה֩ עָלֶ֨יךָ גּ֤וֹי מֵרָחוֹק֙ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִדְאֶ֖ה הַנָּ֑שֶׁר גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תִשְׁמַ֖ע לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃ גּ֖וֹי עַ֣ז פָּנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ יִשָּׂ֤א פָנִים֙ לְזָקֵ֔ן וְנַ֖עַר לֹ֥א יָחֹֽן׃

passages.text: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil, no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks, until they have caused you to perish.
passages.sermon:
Your enemies will come against you.
They will eat the young of your livestock.
They will take the produce of your land.
They will do this until you are destroyed.
They will not leave you any grain.
They will not leave you any new wine.
They will not leave you any oil.
They will not leave you any calves from your herds.
They will not leave you any lambs from your flocks.
They will do this until you perish.
passages.original: וְ֠אָכַל פְּרִ֨י בְהֶמְתְּךָ֥ וּפְרִֽי־ אַדְמָתְךָ֮ עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ יַשְׁאִ֜יר לְךָ֗ דָּגָן֙ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָ֔ר שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ד הַאֲבִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ׃

passages.text: They will besiege all the cities throughout your land, until the high and fortified walls in which you trust have fallen. They will besiege all your cities throughout the land that the LORD your God has given you.
passages.sermon:
A foreign nation will attack you.
They will surround every city in your land.
They will do this until your high and strong walls fall down.
You trust in these walls to protect you.
They will surround every city in your land.
The LORD your God gave you this land.
They will besiege all your cities in this land.
passages.original: וְהֵצַ֨ר לְךָ֜ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶ֗יךָ עַ֣ד רֶ֤דֶת חֹמֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ הַגְּבֹה֣וֹת וְהַבְּצֻר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּהֵ֖ן בְּכָל־ אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְהֵצַ֤ר לְךָ֙ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכָ֨ל־ אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God gave you sons and daughters.
Your enemy will attack you.
Your enemy will surround your city.
Your enemy will cause great distress.
You will suffer hunger during the siege.
You will eat the fruit of your womb.
You will eat the flesh of your sons and daughters.
passages.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ פְרִֽי־ בִטְנְךָ֗ בְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־ לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁר־ יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֖ אֹיְבֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: The most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge his brother, the wife he embraces, and the rest of his children who have survived, refusing to share with any of them the flesh of his children he will eat because he has nothing left in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within all your gates.
passages.sermon:
The most gentle and refined man among you will act harshly.
He will act harshly toward his brother.
He will act harshly toward the wife he embraces.
He will act harshly toward the rest of his surviving children.
He will refuse to give any of them the flesh of his children.
He will eat the flesh of his children himself.
He will have nothing left to share.
This will happen during the siege and distress.
Your enemy will bring this siege and distress upon you.
This will happen within all your gates.
passages.original: הָאִישׁ֙ הָרַ֣ךְ בְּךָ֔ וְהֶעָנֹ֖ג מְאֹ֑ד תֵּרַ֨ע עֵינ֤וֹ בְאָחִיו֙ וּבְאֵ֣שֶׁת חֵיק֔וֹ וּבְיֶ֥תֶר בָּנָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹתִֽיר׃ מִתֵּ֣ת׀ לְאַחַ֣ד מֵהֶ֗ם מִבְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹאכֵ֔ל מִבְּלִ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ ל֖וֹ כֹּ֑ל בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ אֹיִבְךָ֖ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: The most gentle and refined woman among you, so gentle and refined she would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground, will begrudge the husband she embraces and her son and daughter the afterbirth that comes from between her legs and the children she bears, because she will secretly eat them for lack of anything else in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within your gates.
passages.sermon:
The most gentle and refined woman among you will act cruelly.
She is so gentle and refined that she would not set the sole of her foot on the ground.
She will begrudge her husband.
She will begrudge her son.
She will begrudge her daughter.
She will begrudge the afterbirth that comes from between her legs.
She will begrudge the children she bears.
She will secretly eat them.
She will do this because she has nothing else to eat.
This will happen during the siege and distress.
Your enemy will bring this siege and distress upon you within your gates.
passages.original: הָרַכָּ֨ה בְךָ֜ וְהָעֲנֻגָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ נִסְּתָ֤ה כַף־ רַגְלָהּ֙ הַצֵּ֣ג עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵהִתְעַנֵּ֖ג וּמֵרֹ֑ךְ תֵּרַ֤ע עֵינָהּ֙ בְּאִ֣ישׁ חֵיקָ֔הּ וּבִבְנָ֖הּ וּבְבִתָּֽהּ׃ וּֽבְשִׁלְיָתָ֞הּ הַיּוֹצֵ֣ת׀ מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלֶ֗יהָ וּבְבָנֶ֙יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּלֵ֔ד כִּֽי־ תֹאכְלֵ֥ם בְּחֹֽסֶר־ כֹּ֖ל בַּסָּ֑תֶר בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ אֹיִבְךָ֖ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: If you are not careful to observe all the words of this law which are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and awesome name—the LORD your God— He will bring upon you and your descendants extraordinary disasters, severe and lasting plagues, and terrible and chronic sicknesses.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel His law.
God wrote this law in a book.
God commanded Israel to obey every word of this law.
God is glorious and awesome.
God is the LORD your God.
God commanded Israel to fear His name.
If you do not carefully obey all the words of this law,
God will act against you.
God will bring disasters upon you.
God will bring disasters upon your descendants.
God will send great and lasting plagues.
God will send terrible and chronic sicknesses.
passages.original: אִם־ לֹ֨א תִשְׁמֹ֜ר לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את הַכְּתוּבִ֖ים בַּסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה לְ֠יִרְאָה אֶת־ הַשֵּׁ֞ם הַנִּכְבָּ֤ד וְהַנּוֹרָא֙ הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ וְהִפְלָ֤א יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ מַכֹּ֣תְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת מַכּ֣וֹת זַרְעֶ֑ךָ מַכּ֤וֹת גְּדֹלוֹת֙ וְנֶ֣אֱמָנ֔וֹת וָחֳלָיִ֥ם רָעִ֖ים וְנֶאֱמָנִֽים׃

passages.text: He will afflict you again with all the diseases you dreaded in Egypt, and they will cling to you.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God punished Egypt with many diseases.
You were afraid of these diseases in Egypt.
If you do not obey God, He will bring these diseases upon you again.
These diseases will cling to you.
You will suffer from the same diseases you once feared.
passages.original: וְהֵשִׁ֣יב בְּךָ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ מַדְוֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגֹ֖רְתָּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְדָבְק֖וּ בָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: The LORD will also bring upon you every sickness and plague not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will act if you do not obey Him.
The LORD will bring every sickness upon you.
The LORD will bring every plague upon you.
Some of these sicknesses and plagues are not written in this Book of the Law.
The LORD will send them against you.
He will do this until you are destroyed.
passages.original: גַּ֤ם כָּל־ חֳלִי֙ וְכָל־ מַכָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א כָת֔וּב בְּסֵ֖פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את יַעְלֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃

passages.text: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left few in number, because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God made your people very many.
Your people were as many as the stars in the sky.
Now, only a few of you will remain.
This will happen because you did not obey the voice of the LORD your God.
passages.original: וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ בִּמְתֵ֣י מְעָ֔ט תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֱיִיתֶ֔ם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹ֑ב כִּי־ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Just as it pleased the LORD to make you prosper and multiply, so also it will please Him to annihilate you and destroy you. And you will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD made you prosper.
The LORD made you increase in number.
The LORD was pleased to do this for you.
The LORD will also be pleased to destroy you if you disobey.
The LORD will wipe you out.
The LORD will remove you from the land.
You are entering this land to take possession of it.
But the LORD will uproot you from it.
passages.original: וְ֠הָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֨שׂ יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם לְהֵיטִ֣יב אֶתְכֶם֮ וּלְהַרְבּ֣וֹת אֶתְכֶם֒ כֵּ֣ן יָשִׂ֤ישׂ יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לְהַאֲבִ֥יד אֶתְכֶ֖ם וּלְהַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנִסַּחְתֶּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: Then the LORD will scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your fathers have known.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will scatter you among all nations.
He will send you from one end of the earth to the other.
There, you will worship other gods.
These gods are made of wood and stone.
You and your fathers have never known these gods.
passages.original: וֶהֱפִֽיצְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ בְּכָל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ וְעַד־ קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעָבַ֨דְתָּ שָּׁ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־ יָדַ֛עְתָּ אַתָּ֥ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃

passages.text: Among those nations you will find no repose, not even a resting place for the sole of your foot. There the LORD will give you a trembling heart, failing eyes, and a despairing soul.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He will scatter you among many nations.
In those nations, you will not find rest.
You will not have a place to settle your foot.
The LORD will give you a trembling heart there.
Your eyes will grow weak.
Your soul will be full of despair.
passages.original: וּבַגּוֹיִ֤ם הָהֵם֙ לֹ֣א תַרְגִּ֔יעַ וְלֹא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנ֖וֹחַ לְכַף־ רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְנָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה לְךָ֥ שָׁם֙ לֵ֣ב רַגָּ֔ז וְכִלְי֥וֹן עֵינַ֖יִם וְדַֽאֲב֥וֹן נָֽפֶשׁ׃

passages.text: So your life will hang in doubt before you, and you will be afraid night and day, never certain of survival.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites through Moses.
God warned them about the consequences of disobedience.
Your life will always be uncertain.
You will not feel safe.
You will be afraid during the day.
You will be afraid at night.
You will never feel sure that you will survive.
passages.original: וְהָי֣וּ חַיֶּ֔יךָ תְּלֻאִ֥ים לְךָ֖ מִנֶּ֑גֶד וּפָֽחַדְתָּ֙ לַ֣יְלָה וְיוֹמָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ין בְּחַיֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ and in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’—because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights you will see.
passages.sermon:
God warned the Israelites about the consequences of disobedience.
He said they would live among foreign nations.
They would feel constant fear and anxiety.
In the morning, they would say, "If only it were evening!"
In the evening, they would say, "If only it were morning!"
They would feel dread in their hearts.
They would be afraid because of the terrifying things they would see.
passages.original: בַּבֹּ֤קֶר תֹּאמַר֙ מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן עֶ֔רֶב וּבָעֶ֥רֶב תֹּאמַ֖ר מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן בֹּ֑קֶר מִפַּ֤חַד לְבָֽבְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְחָ֔ד וּמִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD will return you to Egypt in ships by a route that I said you should never see again. There you will sell yourselves to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will send you back to Egypt.
You will go in ships.
You will travel on a route I told you never to see again.
You will arrive in Egypt.
You will try to sell yourselves to your enemies.
You will offer yourselves as male slaves and as female slaves.
No one will buy you.
passages.original: וֶֽהֱשִֽׁיבְךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה׀ מִצְרַיִם֮ בָּאֳנִיּוֹת֒ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣רְתִּֽי לְךָ֔ לֹא־ תֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לִרְאֹתָ֑הּ וְהִתְמַכַּרְתֶּ֨ם שָׁ֧ם לְאֹיְבֶ֛יךָ לַעֲבָדִ֥ים וְלִשְׁפָח֖וֹת וְאֵ֥ין קֹנֶֽה׃ס
